note_frame4: Fourth continuation frame stopped at the ~25-30 per-child findings budget (27 new this frame; 130 cumulative), NOT at saturation. Across this frame's passes the new-unique rate ranged ~8-48% (well above the 2% threshold) and never fell below 2% in two consecutive passes, so the cluster has NOT saturated. The DORA/responsible-metrics thread was especially productive (12 new from one CITED-sorted EPMC pass). Cumulative unique (130) remains below the 200-paper floor; the coordinator should fork a further continuation. Suggested remaining threads: OpenAlex snowball_round_4 (Freedman/Begley-Ellis economics-of-reproducibility seeds), deeper data-paper citation-incentive work, field-constrained preprint/peer-review-concordance and team-science/hyperauthorship queries (broad EPMC CITED-sorts return genomics/health-services noise), and research-parasites data-sharing-credit (needs exact-phrase query to avoid biology 'parasites' noise).
